content: Device code flow (RFC 8628) error codes the client must handle distinctly: authorization_pending (AADSTS70016, keep polling), slow_down (increase polling interval by at least 5 seconds), expired_token (stop polling, user_code dead, offer restart), access_denied (user declined, do not retry silently). Microsoft-specific failures a Kodi addon will meet: AADSTS7000218 if Allow public client flows is not enabled on the app registration; AADSTS65001 when the user or admin has not consented, including when tenant-level user consent is disabled so only an admin can grant it; AADSTS650056 for a misconfigured app. Microsoft Entra Conditional Access can block device code flow as an authentication flow, and Microsoft's own guidance recommends blocking device code flow wherever possible - so a Business tenant refusing this exact flow is a realistic, unfixable-from-the-client failure mode that needs its own error state and a custom client_id escape hatch. user_code lifetime is nominally 900s but reported expiring earlier in practice.
